description: UNAVAILABLE — Suunto's API gateway currently rejects this endpoint (/v2/workout/exportGpx) with 401 OperationNotFound on the account it was tested with (September 2026), so the call fails with an 'endpoint unavailable' error; it is not an authentication problem. Would return the workout's GPS route as a GPX 1.1 XML string. Kept so the tool starts working again if Suunto restores the endpoint. Read-only.

workoutKey.description: Opaque server-assigned string returned by list_workouts. Not guessable or constructable — always discover via list_workouts first. Passing an invalid key throws SuuntoNotFoundError.

name: export_workout_gpx
title: Export workout as GPX
